pipeline: Upstream security release / supported branch advisory
Create separately pinned upgrade candidate; old approved artifacts retain historical evidence, operational exposure reviewed
Rebase CEF baseline + Nova series, inspect semantic changes at every gate; no automatic conflict resolution
Resolve deps/toolchain/GN changes; two clean unsigned builds and hashes
Mandatory native security suite and regression against exact artifact/profile
Human review of proof, unclosed gaps, notices and deadlines
Issue certificate binding all modules, gates, config, broker/host ABI, architecture and suite digest
Atomic app-local distribution selection; new sessions only. Never swap engine in a live BrowserSession or auto-fallback to rejected stock/WebView2.
certificateBinds: all loaded binary/resources modules and architecture
proxy/broker version and exact session bootstrap contract
human signoff and validity/security freshness constraints
mandatorySuite: RTC API AND backend: secure context, STUN/TURN TCP/UDP, ICE/data channels, aliases/frame contexts, zero bypass
SW register/activate/start/import/fetch, old cache/profile restore and background resurrection denied
TCP exact endpoint and raw/adopted sockets; UDP connected/unconnected, QUIC/Alt-Svc/HTTP3/WebTransport
Proxy absent/start/killed/restart, direct override/local bypass/PAC/WPAD, wrong proxy and destination auth challenges
DNS mixed/rebind/public->private, prefetch/preconnect/service endpoint/cache/native OS resolver; all destination sockets broker-owned
HTTP public + HTTPS standard success/hostname/chain/invalid/private denial, no MITM
Logical every-hop/new-origin admission + download/frame/subresource/XHR; H2 tunnel coalescing no cross-origin skip
Registered protocol canary scripts/clicks/popups/frames/takeover, lower platform sink zero launches
Takeover confirmed resume/unconfirmed terminal denial, known secret monotonicity/leaf redaction/pre-IPC secrecy
Uploads/downloads/drive-by, staging ownership and effect boundary, process/Job/profile cleanup
rollbackPolicy: Only a still-certified security-acceptable prior source-controlled artifact may be selected explicitly; otherwise Active Web closed. No availability-preserving stock fallback.
responseToSecurityDeadline: If recertification is late or a relevant vulnerability invalidates assumptions, revoke operational availability rather than silently retain stale certification. Cadence tied to upstream advisories, not an invented fixed hours SLA.
